properties.name: Star of Bethlehem
properties.description: Pixel-art lyric video starter. A GDevelop preview is not an encoded video.

events.comment: Positions and the HUD read MusicChannelPlayingOffset on channel 0. They are not driven by a scene timer. At music time 0, Walker top-left is (-48, 109): one 48px cell off the left edge, so the figure walks in. The centered top-left is (136, 109). Walker moves right at WalkSpeedPxPerSec (20) until X reaches 136, which is 9.2 s of music, then stays there. ScrollSeconds is the music time after that arrival. The Walk cycle (frames 1, 2, 3, 2 at 0.22 s) uses the sprite animation clock. Origin stays the default top-left. Point Pivot is the artist's (24, 48) registration and is not the object origin.

Parallax speeds are starter defaults. The art handoff does not specify any. Far hills 4 px/s, mid hills 8, trees 12, ground 20 (same as the walk, so the path keeps up with the feet). Sky and SnowStill do not scroll. Each scrolling object has two instances, TileCopy 0 at x = 0 and TileCopy 1 at x = 640. Every frame their X is -mod(speed * ScrollSeconds, 640) plus TileCopy * 640, so the pair wraps every 640 px.
